reviews.text: Excellent experience, I highly recommend. Very attentive and adapts to the pace of both the owners and the dog. Thank you!

I was looking for a dog trainer who could help me understand my dog, and Laura has a keen sense of observation. Everything became very clear as the sessions progressed, and I saw real results. The exercises really helped me adapt my approach to all sorts of situations, especially in a city like Lyon.
I recommend her 100%!

Laura is a great listener.

We came to see her about our dog Tina, who is very fearful and reactive around people. She gave us lots of advice and helpful tips. We're putting them into practice and seeing progress, even though we know it will take time and effort to achieve real change.

We wholeheartedly recommend Laura! Her sessions were incredibly beneficial and informative for our little puppy and for us. We were looking for a professional, outside perspective that was kind and offered concrete, realistic advice: that's exactly what Laura provided. Beyond her consistently clear and insightful analyses, we were deeply touched by her dedication and the affection she showed for our Linguine. The progress was immediately visible, a true transformation over the course of the sessions! Furthermore, her great availability and flexibility made the follow-up process much easier. Go for it without hesitation! 🩷 (A big thank you also to her dog Anaya, a real sweetheart).
A dog trainer who listens and is caring! His advice is invaluable and, most importantly, it works. After trying several trainers before, I finally got real results. A huge thank you!

I contacted this dog trainer for my two Lhasa Apsos. Walks with them had become difficult, and one was leading the other on. I am more than delighted with the results. Laura is also very observant and attentive. I truly felt supported, and it was very informative. I highly recommend this dog trainer.

I've been living in Lyon for a few months now and I was able to call on Laura for her dog training skills. Due to a recent move, my young beagle, Reese, experienced a change in behavior and was very stressed/excited on every outing. Laura helped us find solutions, calm Reese down, and acclimate him to his new environment. Everything is now going very well for him (and for me), and walks are once again enjoyable and relaxed. I highly recommend Laura for her support and kindness 🤩

A huge thank you to Laura who helped us improve our daily life with our dog Locky. She was a great help, and we saw immediate improvement from our very first session. Locky used to pull a lot on the leash and was very withdrawn; he had trouble interacting with other dogs (he only had eyes for his ball), but thanks to her and Anaya, he's now interested in other dogs and even enjoys playing! She's a very professional and caring person! A dog trainer like her is a rare find these days. I highly recommend her!

It's now a joy for little Aya, our almost 5-month-old Spitz, to see Laura and her little pack, whom she's known since she was 3 months old. Aya has become her best friend, even though Laura corrects her whenever she misbehaves or is a little too insistent (much to our relief). Laura undoubtedly has a top-notch assistant for her work! Aya is starting to behave much better with other dogs and is learning to develop much healthier canine relationships thanks to Laura's guidance.

We've been regularly having our Shiba Inu, Haru, looked after by Laura for the day since he was 4 months old. It was important to us that he meet other dogs in a caring and trusting environment. Haru will soon be 1 year old, and we see the positive effects of each stay on him. Laura and her dog Anaya are a big part of that, because it's not always easy to manage our little ball of energy!! Thank you both! ✨

Laura is a trustworthy person who knows what she's doing with animals. She took care of my cat for 15 days with a daily visit, and everything went very well. I received regular updates and knew my cat would be well cared for. Thank you again for everything! ☺️

My name is Vaya 🐶. I'm 10 months old and I've been going to Laura and "Princess Anaya's" since I was 3 months old. From the very first day, I knew it was a party 🥳 and the sweet life, lounging in a hammock! Actually, I don't go there to be looked after, but just to see my friends 🤩!! It's like recess...
Thanks, Laura 😉 …

I entrusted my little Toffee to Laura for a trial day and then for several days of boarding. Everything went very well thanks to Laura's experience, as Toffee isn't always easy! Communication with Laura was very smooth, with lots of updates about Toffee throughout the first day and during her stay 😍 The stay with Laura did Toffee a world of good; she was very happy and relaxed when she returned home. I definitely plan to repeat the experience! Thank you, Laura!

I highly recommend her!

Laura took care of my little dog Uriel for two weeks. She sent me lots of updates throughout his stay. Uriel was very happy and had a great time!

I left with complete peace of mind. I wouldn't hesitate to entrust him to her again. Thank you, Laura! ☺️

We left our beloved Shiba Inu with Laura for a week while we went on vacation. Before our stay, Laura suggested we do a trial day, followed by a day at Dog Paradise and an overnight stay at her place to see how our Shiba would react. It was the best idea ever, because when we left him for his extended stay, he was thrilled to see Laura again! As a result, his stay went incredibly well; he got lots of cuddles, he played with other dogs… The logistics were easy to manage with Laura at check-in and check-out. She organized everything perfectly. I found my dog ​​happy and full of energy… He'll definitely be coming back to her place many times!
Laura has looked after our dog a few times while we were away, and it always went very well! He's happy to see her every week at Dog Paradise! 😊 …

I always leave Sépia with Laura with complete confidence ☺️
She's been spending her holidays and weekends there for several years now, and it's always a pleasure for my little Finnish Lapphund (even more so with the days spent at Dog Paradise). I'm reassured by the photos and videos she sends throughout her stay 🙂
Thank you for taking such good care of her ❤️
Everything went very well for my little dog Lumi. I had a great experience with Laura, and I thank her for taking such good care of her and for sending me photos. I highly recommend La Petite Meute.

We met Laura over a year ago.

Tesla has been going there regularly ever since and is always delighted to see Laura and her four-legged friends.

I highly recommend it :)
We happily recommend Laura! Targa always comes back very happy with her stays, even more so when there are days at Dog Paradise. She sends photos throughout the stay!

Every Wednesday, Umy happily meets up with Laura and his friends. He's always thrilled to go, and we're lucky enough to receive videos throughout the day showing him having a blast. Laura is not only caring and attentive to the dogs, but she's also given me invaluable advice that has truly improved our daily life. Looking forward to next Wednesday! ☺️

For almost a year now, Laura has been looking after Yuzu on Tuesdays.

She takes him to Dog Paradise, where he meets lots of canine friends, and I've really seen the progress in my Shih Tzu. He's no longer fearful of other dogs, while still being attentive to their reactions. He can now clearly understand if a dog doesn't want to see him and doesn't approach, or if it wants to play and can then go over.
I sincerely believe that these weekly outings help him to channel his energy, to be a well-balanced dog, and ultimately, a happy one. Laura supervises him but, above all, observes him, and her feedback allows me to adjust my behavior with Yuzu and be a better owner for him.
And Yuzu is always thrilled to go, and comes home exhausted but happy! I feel like I have a dog who's truly comfortable in his own skin, and Laura's little pack has a lot to do with it.

Laura looks after my dog ​​(Smoothie) two to three times a week while I'm at work. I have complete confidence in her, and I can see that Smoothie is happy to see her in the morning. As an added bonus, Smoothie comes home tired after a long …
Thanks to Laura, I can always go on vacation with peace of mind knowing my little cat is in good hands. …

We wanted to leave our little Tilt in good hands while we were traveling, and Laura did just that! Tilt is full of energy, and Laura provides him with a reassuring and healthy environment. We are very happy; we wanted to avoid kennels, and Tilt feels right at home with Laura. We highly recommend her.

We were so lucky to entrust our dog to Laura! And what luck we were! Laura is attentive, flexible, and incredibly professional in her approach to animal care! Her advice was invaluable in training our dog, and we know he had a wonderful stay ☺️🙏🏼 Dog Paradise is the perfect place to leave your dog; I highly recommend it!! …

Laura looked after my dog ​​on weekdays when I had to go to the office and during my business trips. She is very responsible and takes her work seriously. Laura also gives dogs the opportunity to go to the fenced dog park where they can run freely and play. My dog ​​loves it!

Thank you, Laura, for Unter and me too.

Our little wildcat arrived home before summer, but I couldn't imagine leaving …

I've had Laura look after my dog ​​twice already, and everything went wonderfully. He was happy to see her again. Laura is available throughout the stay and keeps us updated. A very good experience 😁 …

Umi is always so happy to go to Laura's! I'm so glad I found a trustworthy person to look after my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel since he was 10 months old when I travel. She helps him with his training, just like she does with the other dogs he meets at the boarding kennel. The little bonus: trips to dog paradise!
